label: openhuman-full carries twenty-one vendored crates totalling about 4.38 million lines of Rust, not five, and both trees already hold crates/openhuman-tui, so the topic's premise is wrong on both counts and the five named crates are the smallest end of the tree

tinyeventqueues is the highest-value net-new mechanism: a durable inbound event queue that filters noise before an agent runs, in a plan whose only inbound lever is the roster because every channel message becomes a request
tinyskills carries deterministic discovery and collision precedence for skill bundles, neither of which phase 009 has, and collision precedence is the failure a discovery model creates
tinyjuice is the alternative to the plan's refuse-at-budget policy, and at 636193 lines it is valuable in principle and unreachable in practice, so the plan's caps remain the cheap approximation

tinymcp is a different MCP model from 007's static config filter: it dials servers over Streamable HTTP or a subprocess and browses registries, so server health and registry browsing are the parts worth mirroring

tinydocs turns a validated document spec into office-format bytes and extracts text from DOCX, PPTX and PDF, a capability no phase covers, and its validate-before-writing-bytes discipline matches the plan's own record discipline
